text:
incident-bot: Pager — Elevated 5xx rate detected for tenant 'newport' on Dedicated cluster us-west-2-dc1. Spike started ~4876543000. Current 5xx rate 12% (baseline ~0.2%). Putting channel into incident mode. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/dedicated-5xx-response :rotating_light:

mike (oncall): ack. I'm on it. grabbing traces and checking per-tenant qps. Ben, if you see anything obvious please shout.

carla (eng-runtime): looking into runtime metrics now. KV cache miss rate for newport jumped 18x. Shard-level evictions skyrocketed -> heavy IO and increased tail latency leading to inference timeouts. snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:23Z] kv_evict: tenant=newport shard=3 evicted=1243 inflight=987
[2026-03-15T12:01:24Z] inference:error tenant=newport model=gpt-13 timeout_ms=30000 req_id=ae1f...
[2026-03-15T12:01:25Z] kv_miss_rate tenant=newport miss=0.94
```

mike (oncall): that's consistent with the 5xxs. Running quick metrics query to confirm source of traffic.
```
curl -s "https://internal-metrics/api/query?metric=tenant_qps&tenant=newport&from=4876542800&to=4876543200"
```
response: {"peak_qps": 5200, "baseline_qps": 180} -> 28x increase.

dinesh (support): Newport support channel just pinged us, they see widespread user errors. They say "we didn't deploy anything". I've asked them to check scheduled jobs.

erica (solutions): I DM'd their infra lead, they're running a scheduled nightly evaluation that accidentally ramped concurrency. Asking them to pause.

carla (eng-runtime): mitigation options: 1) tenant-level throttle (soft) 2) evict hot shard(s) 3) add temporary extra capacity to pool 4) route excess to fallback region. Recommend apply 1 + 3 immediately.

mike (oncall): agreed. Applying tenant throttle now. Command: `rctl set-tenant-rate --tenant newport --qps 800 --burst 1600 --reason "emergency throttle: cache thrash"`

deploy-bot: rctl change submitted by mike. config_id=cfg-20260315-9b7c. Applying across us-west-2-dc1 nodes...

deploy-bot: Tenant throttle applied (config_id=cfg-20260315-9b7c). Observability: please allow 30s for metrics to reflect.

mike (oncall): also bumping pool by +2 GPU nodes as hotfix. `scale-pool --cluster us-west-2-dc1 --pool dedicated-gpu --delta +2`

deploy-bot: Autoscaler request accepted. Provisioning nodes (expected ready ~2m).

carla (eng-runtime): meanwhile I'm evicting the hottest shard for newport to break the KV thrash loop. `kvctl evict-shard --tenant newport --shard 3 --force`

carla (eng-runtime): eviction started. monitoring disk IO and tail latency.

incident-bot: Alert update — after throttle + shard eviction, 5xx rate down to 4.1% and falling. Latency p50->p95 improved slightly. Keep monitoring.

dinesh (support): Newport responded — they found a misconfigured evaluation worker that ramped to infinite concurrency. They've paused it. They asked for a short notice before we lift throttle.

mike (oncall): good catch. Keeping throttle and nodes for now. Can we put a temporary per-tenant quota in place to avoid recurrence?

carla (eng-runtime): yes, create a persistent quota ticket. For immediate safety I'll enable stricter soft quota for newport: `quotactl set --tenant newport --tokens-per-sec 200 --burst 500`

deploy-bot: Quota change applied (ticket q-8872).

ben (sre): I'm joining the channel. taking over monitoring at 4876543450 for the on-call handoff. mike, status and outstanding actions?

mike (oncall): handing off — current state: throttle in place (cfg-20260315-9b7c), shard 3 evicted, +2 nodes provisioning, 5xx at 1.1% and trending down, Newport paused load-test. Follow-ups: confirm autoscaled nodes registered, verify no residual background batch jobs from customer, create follow-up RCA.

ben (sre): noted. I'll verify nodes and keep channel updated. scheduling quick postmortem with eng-runtime and support. tagging erica for customer comms.

erica (solutions): I'll draft a customer-facing note explaining cause and actions. Will also coordinate safe lift of throttle once they confirm no active jobs.

incident-bot: Incident state changed to "mitigated". MRR: reduced to <1.5% 5xx across cluster. Incident channel will remain open for RCA coordination.

ben (sre): Verified new nodes came online and joined pool. No further 5xx spikes in last 8 minutes. Marking incident as mitigated. I'll open a postmortem doc and assign owners: eng-runtime (carla) for root cause and quota automation, support (dinesh) for customer comms, infra for capacity automation.

mike (oncall): thanks team. big thumbs to quick responses. :thumbsup:

dinesh (support): Newport confirmed they paused their job and will run a controlled ramp tomorrow. They requested a summary.

ben (sre): closing incident thread; follow-up ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-20260315-4876543210. Postmortem draft due in 48h.

carla (eng-runtime): note for postmortem: consider per-tenant max-inflight + automated detection for cache thrash patterns.

incident-bot: Channel unlocked. If anything else crops up reopen with `incident reopen 4876543210`.
